LocalDreamTextToImage.display_name: LocalDream Text to Image (Prompt to Image)
LocalDreamTextToImage.description: Generate images with Local Dream controlled mode on a phone. Sampling runs on the device; ComfyUI only orchestrates.

prompt.name: Positive Prompt
prompt.tooltip: Prompt sent to Local Dream (77-token CLIP limit).

model.name: Model
model.tooltip: Model id from GET :8808/models. Auto keeps the model currently loaded on the device.

steps.name: Steps
steps.tooltip: Number of sampler steps. DMD2 models usually use 8 steps.

cfg.name: cfg
cfg.tooltip: CFG scale. On NPU, cfg=1.0 skips the unconditional UNet pass.

scheduler.name: Sampler Name
scheduler.tooltip: ComfyUI-style sampler name. A _karras suffix selects the Karras noise schedule.

seed.name: Seed
seed.tooltip: uint32 seed; always sent explicitly for reproducibility.

denoise.name: Denoise
denoise.tooltip: Text-to-image has no denoise field; approximated by effective steps = steps x denoise.

width.name: Width
width.tooltip: Output width, multiple of 8. SDXL uses the aspect ratio instead.

negative_prompt.name: Negative Prompt
negative_prompt.tooltip: Falls back to the default negative prompt in settings when empty.

aspect_ratio.name: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.tooltip: SDXL NPU only; auto derives it from width and height with a 1024px long side.

use_opencl.name: Use OpenCL
use_opencl.tooltip: SD1.5 CPU mode only: switch the MNN backend to GPU OpenCL.

batch_count.name: Batch Count
batch_count.tooltip: Images are generated sequentially and accumulated on one progress bar.

0.name: Image
0.tooltip: Generated image as a ComfyUI IMAGE tensor.

LocalDreamImageToImage.description: Resize a ComfyUI IMAGE to the target size and use it as the img2img base. Connect a mask for inpainting.

model.name: Model
model.tooltip: Model id from GET :8808/models. Auto keeps the currently loaded model.

image.name: Image
image.tooltip: Base image, resized and encoded as PNG before upload.

negative_prompt.name: Negative Prompt
negative_prompt.tooltip: Falls back to the default negative prompt in settings when empty.

aspect_ratio.name: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.tooltip: SDXL NPU only; auto derives it from width and height.

batch_count.name: Batch Count
batch_count.tooltip: With a batched input, one image is generated per batch item.

mask.name: Mask
mask.tooltip: Optional. Enables inpainting; white areas are redrawn.

0.name: Image
0.tooltip: Redrawn image as a ComfyUI IMAGE tensor.
